The modalities were measured on different individuals, so nothing can be matched sample to sample.
What connects them is a fixed vocabulary of named biological concepts. A concept is a set of
features that belong together for a stated biological reason, and every modality is scored on the
same concepts. A concept is the same concept in every modality. The six steps below run in a fixed
order, and the order is part of the method.

They answer one question: does this named concept separate cases from controls, in the modalities
that express it. Two further questions are asked of the same encoding and answered differently.
Whether a group of related concepts moves together where no member of it moves far enough alone,
and whether the collection carries a state that no modality in it could have found. Those come
after the six steps, because both read the encoding the six steps produce.

## 1. Fix the vocabulary

`chorale_concepts()` builds the vocabulary for a collection and reports its coverage. Genes and
proteins reach a concept through their identifiers, mapped to a common identifier space by
`chorale_map()`. Lipid species reach the same concept through their class, since a pathway acts on a
class rather than on one chain length.

Coverage is reported rather than assumed. For every concept and every modality, the number of
features that modality carries for it is recorded, and a modality is counted as expressing a concept
only above a stated number of features. The counts expressible in every modality, in a subset, and
in none are what the vocabulary can and cannot carry for this collection.

## 2. Score every modality on the vocabulary

`chorale_encode()` gives each sample one number per concept: the average standardised level of the
features carrying that concept in that sample. The scores are standardised afterwards, so an effect
on a large concept and an effect on a small one are on one scale.

Nothing in this step reads the design. The concept scores therefore cannot have been shaped by the
contrast they are tested on in step 4.

## 3. Keep what the vocabulary misses

The concept scores are projected out of the assay and independent component analysis is run on what
remains. Those free dimensions carry coordinated variation no concept explains. Because the
projection is onto the space the concept scores span, the residual is exactly orthogonal to every
concept score, so a free dimension cannot absorb concept signal.

How many free dimensions a modality supports is decided by reproducibility rather than by variance.
`chorale_select_factors()` runs the decomposition repeatedly at each candidate count, from different
initialisations and on subsamples of the samples, matches the components one to one, and takes the
largest count at which the weakest component still clears a declared threshold. Two rules bound the
search from above: parallel analysis, which says how many components the residual holds above an
unstructured surrogate, and a cap of one component per five samples, beyond which a component
describes individual samples rather than biology.

A vocabulary can leave nothing to decompose. Concept scores span at most as many directions as the
modality has samples, so a vocabulary with more concepts than samples spans the whole sample space,
the projection reproduces the assay, and the residual is numerical noise. No free dimensions are
fitted in that case, and the modality's free ceiling is reported as zero. Whether a modality has a
free channel at all is therefore set by the size of the vocabulary against its sample count, which
is worth checking before a run rather than after.

## 4. Ask the design whether each concept separates cases from controls

`chorale_concept_evidence()` regresses each concept score on the design within each modality. The
model carries the phenotype and every covariate the modalities share and can jointly estimate, so
the reported phenotype effect is adjusted for them. Continuous covariates enter as standardised
slopes, categorical ones as treatment contrasts on their shared levels.

The modalities are combined by inverse-variance weighting. A modality that measures a concept
precisely counts for more than one that measures it loosely. Effects in opposite directions cancel
rather than add, so a concept the modalities disagree about cannot reach a large combined
statistic. How far they agree is reported beside the combined
statistic, because a statistic carried by one modality against the others is a different finding
from the same statistic carried by all of them.

## 5. Calibrate against a null that keeps the design

The quantity under test is the phenotype coefficient of a model that also carries the covariates the
modalities share, so the null has to be a null for that coefficient. Permuting the phenotype label
would break its relation to those covariates as well, and the permuted designs would be designs the
study could not have produced.

The design is therefore held fixed and the response is what moves. The model without the phenotype
is fitted, its residuals are exchanged, and they are added back to what that model explains. This is
the null of Freedman and Lane (1983): the phenotype keeps exactly the relation to the covariates the
data give it, and only the part of the score those covariates do not explain is exchanged. Samples
are exchanged freely unless the study declares which of them are exchangeable, since a repeated
measure or a processing batch is a fact about the study rather than something a design table can be
read for.

The encoder is never refitted, so the number of permutations is a choice about the resolution the
report needs rather than about what a refit can afford.

Two levels of error control come from the same permutations. The family-wise p-value compares each
concept with the largest statistic anywhere in the vocabulary, which is exact under the dependence
that overlapping concepts have. The q-value is the false discovery rate that null implies at the
same threshold.

## 6. Separate a concept from its neighbourhood

Curated concepts share features, so a signal in one appears in every concept overlapping it. Each
concept is therefore reported a second time with its overlapping neighbours regressed out of its
score. A concept whose statistic survives that carries the signal itself; one whose statistic
collapses is reporting the neighbourhood it sits in.

## Concepts tested as groups

A curated vocabulary names the same process at several resolutions, so a change spread across a
dozen overlapping concepts can leave every one of them below threshold while the group is
unambiguous. Testing one concept at a time cannot see that, because each is compared with the
largest statistic anywhere in the vocabulary and none of them is large.

`chorale_concept_families()` groups concepts by how far they share members, under complete linkage,
so every pair within a family overlaps at least as much as the threshold requires. Families come
from the vocabulary and never from the data, so they are fixed before anything is tested, exactly as
the vocabulary is. A concept in no family stands as its own family of one, so nothing is dropped.

`chorale_family_evidence()` tests a family on the sum of its members' combined statistics,
standardised by the size of the family. The statistic is directional: members pointing the same way
accumulate and members pointing opposite ways cancel, so a family is supported when its members
agree rather than when any one of them is large. Its null reuses the permutations already drawn, and
the direction of each permuted statistic is kept rather than reconstructed afterwards. That matters
more here than anywhere else, because concepts within a family overlap heavily and only a null
carrying that dependence gives their sum a correct distribution.

## One state estimated from every modality at once

Steps 4 and 5 combine separately estimated per-modality effects. That is a meta-analysis: the
modality is the unit of estimation, and what is estimated is a scalar each modality could in
principle have estimated alone. A modality that cannot express a concept contributes nothing to it.

`chorale_joint_state()` estimates a different object. Every modality is described on the same
vocabulary, and every score is a weighted mean of standardised feature values, so the score matrices
share their columns and sit on one scale. They are stacked by row into a single matrix of every
sample in the collection against every concept, and decomposed once. The concept loadings that come
out are common to the collection by construction rather than matched across modalities afterwards.

What this recovers is a direction in concept space, of dimension the size of the vocabulary. Where
the vocabulary holds more concepts than any one modality has samples, which is the usual case, no
modality can identify such a direction on its own and the stacked collection can. That is the sense
in which the collection carries something none of its members carries.

Two things are removed before stacking. Each concept is centred and scaled within its modality, so a
platform's level and spread cannot drive a component and only variation between samples measured the
same way survives. Then whatever a modality's own nuisance structure contributes is regressed out of
that modality's scores: study, acquisition batch, colonisation, region. Those need not be shared
with any other modality, which is what makes them adjustable here and not in a model the modalities
hold in common.

A concept a modality cannot express is missing rather than zero. After centring, zero is that
concept's mean, so writing zero would enter a measurement claiming the modality observed exactly
average. The entry carries no weight in the fit instead, and the concept is estimated from the
modalities that measure it. Restricting the vocabulary to concepts every modality expresses would
discard most of it and reinstate the narrowest modality as the limit on the whole collection.

`chorale_joint_evidence()` then asks whether a sample's position along a component moves with the
phenotype, adjusting for the covariates the modalities share and for the modality itself. Without
the modality term a component that merely ordered the modalities would appear to separate cases from
controls whenever the modalities differ in composition. Residuals are exchanged within modality, so
every permuted collection has the composition the study produced. The same effect read within each
modality alone is reported beside the joint one, as a description and not a condition.

## A direction tested where it was not estimated

A permutation asks whether structure could have arisen by chance given this design. It cannot ask
whether the structure transfers.

`chorale_joint_transfer()` holds each modality out in turn, estimates the state from the rest, and
projects the held-out samples onto the concept loadings that come out. Whether those projections
separate cases from controls is then tested in the held-out modality alone. The loadings carry none
of that modality: not its samples, its batches, its assay or its preparation. Structure a modality's
own nuisance produced can inflate a component fitted with that modality in, but it cannot produce a
direction over concepts that predicts the phenotype in a cohort sharing none of it.

It is also the positive claim rather than only its defence. A direction estimated without a cohort,
which orders that cohort by disease state, is what it means for a collection of separately deposited
studies to carry one biology.

Each held-out fit is its own decomposition, and neither the order of its components nor their sign
is identified by the method. A reference fitted on the whole collection therefore supplies one set
of names, and each held-out component is matched to it by how far their concept loadings agree. The
reference contributes nothing to the statistic: the direction tested is the one fitted without the
held-out modality, and the p-value is on the magnitude of its effect, so neither the name nor the
orientation can change what is concluded.

## What the phenotype is compared against

A vocabulary that answers to any strong contrast is not telling you about the disease.
`chorale_concept_specificity()` tests each covariate the modalities share in the phenotype's place,
over the same vocabulary and against the same null. Because the encoding never read the design, the
concept scores are computed once and every covariate reuses them, so the comparison costs the
permutations and nothing else.

A covariate is tested on the terms it contributes to the model: a contrast per level for a
categorical one, a standardised slope for a continuous one. Recoding a continuous covariate into a
contrast would give it one level per sample, leave no residual degrees of freedom, and turn a
failure to estimate into an appearance of specificity.

## What the free dimensions add

The concept channel is fitted first, so the free dimensions hold only what is orthogonal to every
concept score. `chorale_free_dimensions()` tests each of them against the same permutations and
names the features loading on it most heavily. A dimension called there is a candidate outside the
vocabulary, described by its features and not identified by them.
